identity.title: Locally Homogeneous Axiom A Flows I: Projective Anosov Subgroups and Exponential Mixing
identity.page_convention: One-based physical PDF pages; printed source page numbers agree.

coverage.items: Identity; definitions of the projective contact flow; Theorems A-H and their mutual scope
coverage.result: Full theorem and hypothesis comparison. Distinguish scalar versus form operators, elementary versus non-elementary groups, compact basic set versus ambient manifold, and time scales. Findings P001/P002 and the explicit application qualifiers apply.

coverage.items: Liouville/Reeb construction, primal and dual foliations, projective normalization
coverage.result: Checked alpha(v)=1 double cover, Reeb vector (v,-alpha), positive pairing and analytic ambient distributions.

coverage.items: Section 2 definitions through 2.20; Propositions 2.7,2.9,2.15,2.18,2.19 and Lemmas 2.10,2.11,2.17
coverage.result: Read the group/word-length/boundary/eigenvalue-gap definitions and convergence implications, transverse limit maps and proximal growth. The literal cyclic boundary is retained explicitly in P002; no hidden non-elementary convention imported.
Followed properness using positive normalized pairing and growth contradiction. Correct dual exponent in Lemma 3.5 is -lambda_d= lambda_1(gamma^-1), while the primal period remains lambda_1(gamma).

Hopf/logarithmic cocycle and refraction conjugacy checked. Independently repaired inverse/primal-dual labels in Lemma 3.10 as fully derived in the report. Non-wandering/trapped/periodic-closure identification checked with cyclic two-component exception.
Hyperbolicity uses the pulled-back Anosov tangent-bundle contraction, not ambient e^t alone. GW hypotheses checked. The elementary sentence must retain two periodic components.
Verified rational local chart and holonomy calculations, compact Lipschitz bounds, and local-product domain. P005 gives an admissible counterexample to the ambient quantifier.

Local spanning checked via a smaller open set avoiding the repeller, a sufficiently large power, invariant finite-dimensional span and minimality. Basis chosen inside delta/2 and compact finite cover give uniform linear distortion. Both Stoyanov distortion clauses derived, without pinching.

Temporal distance -log(1+beta(u)/beta(v')) and half-linear lower bound checked at fixed scale. The order of epsilon/delta/d0 quantifiers is separately retained as NE001; no guessed counterexample asserted.

Matched Lipschitz holonomy, distortion, non-elementarity and eventual contraction with Stoyanov's original statements. C5 Corollary 1.5 really permits Holder potentials; the analytic flow has the needed regularity. NE001 is the identified remaining input.

Weighted continuation checked against the original Pollicott proof. Global continuation checked through DG/afterword/BWS with orientation twist. DP survey's surface interval reduction and unproved exact evaluation line are not certified for general dimension; the unweighted zero-free/counting conclusion follows directly from checked Stoyanov Corollary 1.4 once its hypotheses hold. Polynomial t factors are absorbed by reducing the exponential rate. Cyclic pole exception is P002.

coverage.items: Theorems 9-11; scalar resolvent, spectral parameter and form lifts
coverage.result: Actual original definitions and wavefront conditions compared. Independent compact semigroup exclusion proves P001; constant-potential residue calculation proves P004. -iX to -X rotation checked. Actual source overbars are present, so extraction losses are not classified as errors. The source's explicit p.43 mention of forms is acknowledged.

Negative/convex-cocompact assumptions compared to original DGK definitions and theorem. Exact tangent pairing exposes P003 and corrected inverse/flow relation are verified. Restriction to trapped geodesics, irreducibility and scalar/form distinction retained.

Checked Hilbert domain/adjoint extreme gaps, positive cone normalization, convex-gradient Lipschitz graph argument, rank-one tensor inverse and the factor-two time change. T_Ad=2 T_BH, h_BH=2 h_Ad, zeta_BH(s)=zeta_Ad(s/2). A Holder conjugacy alone does not transport arbitrary distributions and wavefront products. Ellipsoid/non-ellipsoid distinction and one-dimensional cyclic boundary retained.
Read all reference entries and version identifiers; corrected running-head surname not substituted for title-page author identity. Original public sources acquired with actual byte/hash records.

limits.item: Uniform scale-independent non-integrability cone angle is not established by the written order of choices. No admissible counterexample to the intended mixing conclusion is asserted.
Core original statements, relevant proof passages and hypotheses checked as recorded. This is not a recursive reproof of every foundational reference.
Assigned source is arXiv:2403.14257v1; conclusions are not asserted for an unexamined later version of record. Reference preprint/author versions are separately identified.
A corrected form-valued leading-resonance theorem for all open basic sets and low-regularity Hilbert applications is not supplied by this initial review.
